dct_title_s: Democratic Republic of the Congo Subnational Population and Housing Data Tables with Administrative Boundaries, Based on Surveys
dct_description_sm: The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first- and second- order administrative divisions, aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided. The tabular data contain total population for 2019 (population estimates), household characteristics, IDP movements, people in need, and tribe and religion.
